records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. Information on the use of amlodipine in pregnancy is very limited. Most available information on the use of calcium channel blockers as a group in human pregnancy does not suggest an increased chance of birth defects.
records.source_section: Does taking amlodipine increase the chance of birth defects?
